name: tvOS Apps
description: Personal Apple TV repo for FlareStore. tvOS apps only - the big-screen shelf.

apps.localizedDescription: Stremio's official Apple TV app: movies, series, live TV and add-ons in one place. These are Stremio's own builds, mirrored from their CDN (dl.strem.io) to GitHub so this repo can track them - the 2.1.1 (build 25) files were verified byte-identical to Stremio's official copies.
apps.name: Stremio
apps.subtitle: Freedom to stream

apps.localizedDescription: A native tvOS port of NuvioMobile: the same Nuvio account and addons, rebuilt with a SwiftUI focus-engine frontend for the big screen. The IPA links straight to the official youngchris29-art/NuvioTV GitHub release, and this repo tracks new releases automatically. Requires tvOS 26.
apps.name: NuvioTV
apps.subtitle: Nuvio for Apple TV (youngchris29 port)

apps.localizedDescription: A Nuvio client for Apple TV. The IPA links straight to the official bobsupra/NuvioTVOS GitHub release, and this repo tracks new releases automatically.
apps.name: Nuvio TV
apps.subtitle: Nuvio tvOS client (bobsupra)

apps.localizedDescription: A native SwiftUI media player for Apple TV: addon and debrid streaming, Trakt/TMDB, and Nuvio account sync. This is the Sideload build from the official prehakanson-art/OrivioTVAppleTV GitHub releases, and this repo tracks new releases automatically.
apps.name: Orivio TV
apps.subtitle: tvOS media player with Nuvio sync

apps.localizedDescription: Provenance is a multi-system retro emulator for Apple TV covering 60+ systems — Nintendo, Sega, Atari, Sony and more — with a redesigned tvOS interface, iCloud sync for ROMs, saves and artwork, RetroAchievements and video filters. Open source by the Provenance team; builds link straight to their official GitHub releases.
apps.name: Provenance
apps.subtitle: Multi-system retro emulator — 60+ systems

versions.localizedDescription: 3.3.0: iCloud/CloudKit sync for ROMs, save states, BIOS files and artwork; a completely redesigned tvOS interface; a unified video filter and shader pipeline across cores; RetroArch GLES 3D core support; and a long list of core, controller and stability fixes.
